description:
Data from one connected third-party connector: pick `connector`, then `report`. For what each report returns, its parameters and gotchas, call get_help("<connector>").
• triple-whale (attribution): summary, attributions, by_channel, product_attribution, channel_by_model, journey, pps
• klaviyo (email): campaign_summary, campaigns, top_campaigns, flow_summary, flows, top_flows, list_summary, lists, product_attribution, signup_trends, available_metrics
• sendy (email lists, current snapshot only): list_summary, lists
• gorgias (support): summary, daily, tickets, by_channel, satisfaction, top_tags
• recharge (subscriptions): summary, metrics, cancellation_reasons, upcoming_charges, failed_charges
• google-search-console (SEO): summary, top_queries, top_pages, trends, by_country, by_device, keyword_movers, new_keywords, page_ranking_changes, anomalies, zero_traffic, branded_split, cannibalization
• clarity (UX sessions): summary, ux_issues, by_dimension, trends
• youtube: summary, videos, top_videos, video_details, search_transcripts
• google-ads (ads + live change log): summary, campaigns, daily, by_campaign_type, by_device, by_network, change_history, search_terms, ads, ad_groups, keywords, impression_share, campaign_settings, shopping_products, conversion_reconciliation
• xero (accounting): financials, cash, invoices, bills, expenses, trend
• ringcentral (calls): summary, daily, calls, correlate, voicemails, voicemail_probe, by_agent, account
• reviewsio (Reviews.io stats/NPS; get_reviews covers reviews from every provider): stats, nps_trend, stats_trend, surveys, survey_responses, reply_stats, unanswered
• smile (loyalty): summary, points_activity, top_members, vip_tiers, redemption_patterns, engagement
• swish (wishlists): summary, top_products, demand_trends, metrics
• woocommerce: summary, top_products, orders, customers, low_stock
• meta-ads, tiktok-ads: summary, campaigns, daily
• shipstation: summary, carrier_breakdown, fulfillment_speed, daily
`days` looks AHEAD on recharge but BACK on youtube and swish.

_offset.description: Pagination offset; use when _pagination.hasMore is true.

campaignId.description: google-ads: one campaign (which reports honour it: get_help("google_ads")).

channel.description: gorgias tickets, triple-whale: filter by channel.

connector.description: Which third-party connector to query. One that isn't connected returns `<connector>_not_connected` with how to connect it; call get_data_sources to see what is connected.

days.description: recharge: days AHEAD to forecast. youtube, swish: days BACK.

expandNegatives.description: google-ads campaign_settings: include negative keyword text.

granularity.description: triple-whale by_channel: total, daily or by_store. smile points_activity: day, week or month.

limit.description: Rows per call, max 100 (google-ads search_terms: 1000). Larger values are reduced and _limitNote says so; page with _offset.

maxScore.description: reviewsio unanswered: this rating or lower.

metric.description: klaviyo top_campaigns/top_flows: revenue, openRate or clickRate.

page.description: search-console: on top_queries, ONE exact page (its search terms); on other reports, a path filter like pagePath.

pagePath.description: search-console, any report: only URLs containing this path, e.g. '/products/'.

periodType.description: triple-whale: rolling window. Omit it and pass dates for a fixed range.

report.description: Report name. The tool description lists them per connector.

segment.description: google-ads campaigns: 'day' adds a daily series per campaign (max 20 campaigns).

sortBy.description: search-console top_queries/top_pages: clicks or impressions. smile top_members: pointsBalance, totalEarned or totalSpent.

source.description: triple-whale journey/pps: acquisition source (not the connector).

status.description: klaviyo, gorgias, woocommerce, google-ads: filter by status.

store.description: search-console: store key, picks that store's property.

name: get_connector_data
title: Data from a connected app
